description: Compare cloud compute instance pricing across AWS, Azure, GCP, DigitalOcean, OCI, OVH, and Alibaba. Filter by region, provider, vCPUs, memory, category, processor, or use case. Use this for 'the cheapest 8 vCPU / 32 GiB instance in Europe', and for what a commitment saves: each row gives the Linux list price in USD per hour on demand, on spot, and under a 1-year and 3-year commitment (savings plan, Google CUD, reservation) as an effective hourly rate, each with its saving against that row's on-demand rate. A row with no commitment rate says so. Not every price column is live: `provenance.priceTypes` says which of each provider's price columns come from a live API, which are static constants, and which are unavailable, and `provenance.staticPriceColumns` lists the non-live ones outright; a savings-plan or reserved rate that appears there is a static estimate, not a live quote. Prices are returned as the catalogue serves them and dated by `provenance`.

category.description: Instance category. Must be one of these exactly (case-insensitive): General Purpose, Compute Optimized, Memory Optimized, Storage Optimized, GPU / Accelerated, Burstable. Any other string returns zero matches rather than an error.

processor.description: Processor. Matched by exact equality (case-insensitive), so a partial value like 'H100' returns nothing. Known values: Intel, AMD, Graviton, Trainium, Inferentia, Ampere, Axion, ARM, NVIDIA T4, NVIDIA V100, NVIDIA A100, NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA L4, NVIDIA A10G, NVIDIA Other. 'NVIDIA Other' is every NVIDIA GPU without a label of its own (L40S, H200, B200, RTX and older parts).

provider.description: Cloud provider. Must be one of these exactly (case-insensitive): AWS, Azure, GCP, DigitalOcean, OCI, OVH, Alibaba. Any other string returns zero matches rather than an error.

region.description: Pricing region: us-east, us-west, europe, asia-pacific. Default: us-east

sortBy.description: Sort by: price, vcpus, memory, pricePerVCPU. Default: price

useCase.description: Use case. Must be one of these exactly (case-insensitive): Web App, Database, HPC, ML & AI, Dev/Test, Big Data. Any other string returns zero matches rather than an error.

name: compare-compute-pricing
title: Compare Cloud Compute Pricing
